title: Photograph of a small white cardboard/foamboard room model with a lit lamp and electronics
objects_and_counts: One lit screw-base lamp or LED bulb installed in a white lamp holder in the upper right compartment (1 visible, brightly lit).
A multi-room scaled model or mock-up constructed from white cardboard or foamboard with interior partitions forming at least four distinct compartments visible from above.

One small round dark dome device in the lower-left compartment, mounted against a vertical partition and held with black tape (1 visible dome device; exact device type not determined from appearance).
One small rectangular PCB or sensor board with a 4-wire ribbon/cable attached, located near the top centre edge inside the mock-up (1 visible PCB/board assembly).
One blue terminal-block or connector on the left side wall of the model (1 visible).
Multiple runs of insulated wires visible outside and at the edges of the model (several wire bundles; exact count cannot be reliably determined).
Multiple pieces of black adhesive tape securing components and seams (at least 6 separate pieces of tape visibly placed in different locations).
spatial_relations: The photograph is taken from above looking down into the mock-up so the top of the image shows the far side of the model and the bottom shows the near side.
The lit lamp is in the upper right compartment and occupies most of that compartment's floor area.
A central vertical partition runs roughly top-to-bottom slightly right of centre, dividing the model into left and right zones.
The left zone is further subdivided into multiple smaller rooms by perpendicular partitions; the lower-left of those contains the dark dome device.
The small PCB/sensor board is mounted at the top centre edge of the model interior, just inside the far wall.
The blue terminal block is attached to the left interior wall in the middle-left area of the model.
Black tape strips are positioned along seams and at component mounting points, often adjacent to partitions and the dome device.
colours_and_materials: Most structural surfaces are white — the model appears built from white cardboard or foamboard panels.
Black adhesive tape and black electrical insulation are used repeatedly to secure components and seams.
The lamp is white (bulb) and the lamp holder is white plastic.
The small dome device in the lower-left is dark (black or very dark grey) and appears to be plastic or coated material.
Wires visible include black, red and possibly yellow/green insulation (exact conductor colours visible at cable ends).
The small PCB/sensor board shows typical PCB colours (dark board with small multi-coloured wires attached).
uncertainties: No printed room name, number or signage is legible in the image; location cannot be determined from the photo.
